One of the best fitness studios in South Mumbai side. It’s been almost a year attending classes and it has transformed me to a much healthy version of myself. I love attending Pilates, Yin Yoga,  Strength and Cardio sessions!

Schedule flexibility is what makes this space unique! Trainers are friendly and qualified, which results in quality sessions.

featured_reviews.name: vaishali mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being part of this studio over the past two years has genuinely been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health and fitness. I’m noticeably stronger, fitter, and more confident in my abilities than when I first started — and that progress says a lot about the environment here.

The instructors are incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and truly professional. They focus on form, safety, and pushing you just the right amount, so you’re constantly improving without feeling overwhelmed.

What truly makes this place special is the energy. The vibe is positive, motivating, and welcoming, and the variety in workouts keeps things fresh and challenging. Training alongside a driven and encouraging group of people makes every session something to look forward to.

featured_reviews.name: Tanuja Gahane
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently joined the Studio one life by Rebant. The trainers are highly professional, experienced, approachable and pay attention to each and every one around. The studio maintains excellent cleanliness. Infact the classes are cleaned after each session. The sessions are fun, high-energy, and suitable for all fitness levels. The music, atmosphere, and group vibe make exercising feel less like a task and more like an experience. They also provide with flexible timings so you can join with any one of the classes for the day. That feels like the best hour of the day indeed. Kudos to Rebant, Harshita and their team for all the efforts and attention they put in.

featured_reviews.name: Jaya Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
If mornings had a personality, mine would definitely be Studio1 Life.

I’ve been coming here since October’25 mostly for yoga (with a recent Zumba comeback 💃)and honestly, it’s become my favourite part of the day.

The yoga classes with Akshay (and sometimes Rebant) are anything but routine. Every single session feels fresh, thoughtfully designed and just the right mix of challenge and energising. From power yoga to Pilates to yin yoga: each class is like a mini reset button for the mind, body and soul.

What I love most; The instructors are absolute pros, focused, attentive and genuinely invested in you. They keep things engaging without any fluff… it’s fun, but with purpose.

And then there’s Zumba with Rebant, pure joy! It’s not just a workout, it’s a full-on vibe. The music, the energy, the steps… one minute you’re in Mumbai, the next you’re dancing your way through Mexico or Spain 🌍🔥

If you’re looking for a place that makes you want to wake up to the rhythm of your body,  this is it. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Taurani
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely loving this workout Studo 1! 🤩 They've got an insane variety of classes - Pilates, yoga, strength training, Zumba... you name it! The trainers are top-notch with full of energy, always pushing me to be my best self. What I love most is the flexibility - no advance booking needed, just show up and get moving. :) Whether you're a fitness newbie or a seasoned pro, this place has got you covered.

featured_reviews.name: Deval Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:

I have had the privilege of training at Sprinters Sports Club, and I must say it has been nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment I stepped onto the track, I was welcomed by a highly professional and supportive environment that fosters both athletic growth and mental fortitude.

The coaching staff at Sprinters Sports Club is second to none. Dr. Ravindra Kumar Walmiki, the head coach, is not only incredibly knowledgeable but also certified and highly experienced. His approach to training is both scientific and functional, ensuring every session is tailored to maximize performance. Unlike traditional coaches who often encourage running blindly, Dr. Walmiki’s methods are rooted in science and focus on building functional strength and technique. He integrates cutting-edge training principles, ensuring athletes train smartly, not just hard. His deep understanding of biomechanics and sprinting physiology truly sets him apart, making workouts not just effective but also purposeful.

The facilities are world-class, with a well-maintained synthetic track, state-of-the-art training equipment, and all the necessary amenities to provide an ideal setting for both training and recovery. The positive energy among fellow athletes creates a competitive yet supportive atmosphere that pushes everyone to bring their best every day.

I can confidently say that Sprinters Sports Club is a place where athletes are shaped into champions, thanks in large part to the guidance of Dr. Ravindra Kumar Walmiki. I highly recommend this club to anyone looking to improve their sprinting performance, from beginners to elite sprinters.

A top-tier training ground for future stars!

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Durdhawle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was never really into fitness before joining Fitness Den. One random day while sitting in my office, I decided that it was finally time to start focusing on my health and fitness. I searched for several gyms and came across Fitness Den by Suhas Khamkar. I called them and scheduled a gym visit.

The moment I entered the gym, I instantly felt that this was the right place for me. The ambience, energy, and overall environment were extremely motivating. During my visit, I met Vishakha from the front desk, who guided me very well and offered me a great membership package.

On my very first day, I met Trainer Mohsin Ali, who is now my Personal Trainer. From day one, his guidance was exceptional. Initially, I had no intention of taking personal training, but after interacting with him and understanding his approach towards fitness and health, I felt confident that I should take PT sessions.

That decision truly changed things for me. Mohsin Sir advised me to get certain blood tests done. Although I looked fine externally, the reports revealed high cholesterol, triglycerides, and uric acid levels. I was honestly shocked. When I shared the reports with Mohsin Sir, he calmly said, “Don’t panic, we will reverse it with proper training and discipline.”

From that moment, my mindset completely changed. I became determined to work on myself seriously, and with Mohsin Sir’s constant guidance, motivation, and training, I have started seeing real results. He helped me transform not just physically, but mentally as well — from being careless about my health to becoming someone who genuinely takes care of his body and lifestyle.

The ambience, and overall atmosphere at Fitness Den are excellent, and the trainers are highly supportive and knowledgeable. Joining this gym has truly been one of the best decisions for my health and fitness journey.

featured_reviews.name: Amey vadhavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been going to Bombay high for the past 4 months, and it's been a great experience. The equipment is modern and well-maintained, the trainers are friendly and professional, and the crowd is respectful. The gym stays clean and apart from few days as exception never feels overcrowded. I enjoy the weekend yoga  sessions. Highly recommended for beginners and experienced fitness enthusiasts alike.

**Feedback/Suggestions for Improvement:**

- There should be more sessions available, and the session timetable needs to be clearer. It would be helpful if it were regularly published on a screen or notice board for members to see.
- Introducing more group sessions (like HIIT, functional training, etc.) would help engage more trainers and members. This would be especially beneficial for those who do not have a personal trainer, as it would introduce them to new forms of training.
- The BMI machine in the gym could be improved. It doesn't have a history feature or the ability to provide a soft copy of results. Having the option to receive PDF reports for historical reference would be great—as even many basic gyms offer these features.
- Lastly, a positive mention: the cleaning staff does an excellent job keeping the facility clean and hygienic.

Overall, I look forward to seeing these improvements in the future.
